source_scope.lane: SOMA implementation failure lineage, deployment safety semantics, transfer to adaptive visual learning

crossread.dedup_decision: Prior receipt already preserves the broad SOMA train/evaluate/deploy/rollback lifecycle and historical 18.7-minute repository-reported run. This delta adds only concrete safety/metric/schema/concurrency failure lineage and the frozen-head safety-check implementation gap; no duplicate earned-work hours are awarded.

findings.claim: services/soma/safety_check.py documents a third held-out perplexity/performance gate, but the frozen-head implementation does not execute a perplexity or held-out behavioral test. It performs adapter drift, per-layer similarity, optional baseline drift, NaN/Inf and large-weight sanity only.
findings.implication: Parameter-space sanity is insufficient as a promotion oracle. Any adaptive visual learner must require held-out semantic behavior tests such as class accuracy, calibration, open-set rejection and regression checks before promotion.

findings.claim: The SOMA audit lineage records failures in score-schema mapping, corrupted timestamp recovery, EMA blending across changed adapter-key sets, near-zero drift handling, large-weight thresholding, model cleanup, background-thread shutdown and probe substring matching.
findings.implication: Adaptive learning safety must test schema/version evolution, restart/recovery, concurrency shutdown, candidate-state completeness and metric validity, not only model quality.

findings.claim: SOMA carries explicit feedback and heuristic conversation scores into weighted training loss, while snapshot/EMA/rollback concepts surround deployment.
findings.constraint: The source code describes explicit user feedback as ground truth for conversation quality. That terminology must not transfer to perception: user feedback and labels are provenance-bearing supervision signals, while sensor observations and open-set uncertainty remain separate evidence classes.

findings.claim: A strong transferable adaptive-visual lifecycle is: trusted labeled example with provenance/tier -> versioned candidate prototype/classifier update -> offline/held-out semantic tests -> state/weight sanity -> staged promotion -> last-known-good snapshot -> rollback/rebuild on regression.
findings.falsifier: A simpler learner without this lifecycle matches or exceeds error rate, calibration, recovery and resource bounds under cold-start, mislabel, OOD, restart and concurrent-update stress tests.

branch_feedback.frank: Retina/Micro Visual Classifier promotion must separate supervision provenance from sensor truth and expose version identity plus last-known-good rollback.
branch_feedback.harness: Add failure-injection tests for mislabeled examples, schema/version drift, incomplete candidate state, restart during update, concurrent learner shutdown, OOD/open-set regression and rollback restoration.
branch_feedback.claycode: Express candidate/promotion/rollback as explicit typed transitions with provenance, version, authority and recovery receipts; never infer successful promotion from parameter drift alone.
branch_feedback.unifieddb: Persist classifier/prototype version, feature-backbone compatibility, example provenance/tier, calibration/open-set metrics, candidate state and rollback lineage independently from sensor facts.
branch_feedback.claygraph: Model learned familiarity associations as provenance-bearing hypotheses/weights; activation must not promote a label to sensor truth.
branch_feedback.emergenz: NO_CHANGE: this delta is adaptation/recovery evidence, not evidence for causal emergence or consciousness.

earned_work_mapping.reason: Broad SOMA lifecycle already received provisional earned-work mapping in prior receipt; this delta strengthens validation requirements rather than adding duplicate reuse credit.

progress_accounting.reason: Combined Drive + Project-Frankenstein exact obligation denominator remains unfrozen.
progress_accounting.project_frankenstein_surface_delta: GitHub connector now exposes a large bounded commit-history search surface and direct commit diffs, but still exposes no recursive read-tree or exhaustive paginated commit/tree denominator; exact history/tree closure remains unprovable on this surface.

next_discriminating_test: In H1/H2 adaptive-visual learner, inject label noise, OOD classes, restart mid-update, schema version change and concurrent shutdown; require semantic held-out gates plus exact rollback restoration before candidate promotion.
